    </main>

    <script>

        const lessonProgress = {

            game1: false,

            game2: false,

            writing: false,

            totalTasks: 3

        };



        function updateLessonProgress() {

            let completedTasks = 0;

            if (lessonProgress.game1) completedTasks++;

            if (lessonProgress.game2) completedTasks++;

            if (lessonProgress.writing) completedTasks++;

            

            const percentage = Math.round((completedTasks / lessonProgress.totalTasks) * 100);

            const progressBar = document.getElementById('lesson-progress-bar');

            

            progressBar.style.width = percentage + '%';

            progressBar.textContent = percentage + '%';

            

            document.getElementById('stat-game1').classList.toggle('completed', lessonProgress.game1);

            document.getElementById('stat-game1').querySelector('.stat-value').textContent = lessonProgress.game1 ? 'âœ“' : 'â—‹';

            

            document.getElementById('stat-game2').classList.toggle('completed', lessonProgress.game2);

            document.getElementById('stat-game2').querySelector('.stat-value').textContent = lessonProgress.game2 ? 'âœ“' : 'â—‹';

            

            document.getElementById('stat-writing').classList.toggle('completed', lessonProgress.writing);

            document.getElementById('stat-writing').querySelector('.stat-value').textContent = lessonProgress.writing ? 'âœ“' : 'â—‹';

            

            if (percentage === 100) {

                document.getElementById('global-mission-complete').style.display = 'block';

                progressBar.style.background = 'linear-gradient(90deg, var(--gold) 0%, var(--cyan) 100%)';

                document.getElementById('global-mission-complete').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });

            }

        }



        const vocabData = {

            passion: { def: "A strong feeling of enthusiasm or excitement for something.", trans: "Äam mÃª: Má»™t cáº£m giÃ¡c nhiá»‡t tÃ¬nh hoáº·c pháº¥n khÃ­ch máº¡nh máº½ Ä‘á»‘i vá»›i má»™t Ä‘iá»u gÃ¬ Ä‘Ã³." },

            dedication: { def: "The quality of being committed to a task or purpose.", trans: "Sá»± cá»‘ng hiáº¿n: Pháº©m cháº¥t cam káº¿t vá»›i má»™t nhiá»‡m vá»¥ hoáº·c má»¥c Ä‘Ã­ch." },

            enthusiasm: { def: "Intense and eager enjoyment or interest.", trans: "LÃ²ng nhiá»‡t tÃ¬nh: Sá»± thÃ­ch thÃº hoáº·c quan tÃ¢m mÃ£nh liá»‡t vÃ  hÃ¡o há»©c." },

            commitment: { def: "The state or quality of being dedicated to a cause.", trans: "Sá»± cam káº¿t: Tráº¡ng thÃ¡i hoáº·c pháº©m cháº¥t táº­n tá»¥y cho má»™t má»¥c tiÃªu." },

            drive: { def: "Strong motivation to achieve goals.", trans: "Äá»™ng lá»±c: Äá»™ng lá»±c máº¡nh máº½ Ä‘á»ƒ Ä‘áº¡t Ä‘Æ°á»£c má»¥c tiÃªu." },

            perseverance: { def: "Persistence in doing something despite difficulty or delay.", trans: "Sá»± kiÃªn trÃ¬: Sá»± bá»n bá»‰ lÃ m Ä‘iá»u gÃ¬ Ä‘Ã³ báº¥t cháº¥p khÃ³ khÄƒn hoáº·c trÃ¬ hoÃ£n." },

            motivation: { def: "The reason one has for acting or behaving in a particular way.", trans: "Äá»™ng cÆ¡: LÃ½ do Ä‘á»ƒ má»™t ngÆ°á»i hÃ nh Ä‘á»™ng hoáº·c cÆ° xá»­ theo má»™t cÃ¡ch cá»¥ thá»ƒ." },

            curiosity: { def: "A strong desire to know or learn something.", trans: "Sá»± tÃ² mÃ²: Mong muá»‘n máº¡nh máº½ Ä‘á»ƒ biáº¿t hoáº·c há»c má»™t Ä‘iá»u gÃ¬ Ä‘Ã³." },

            ambition: { def: "A strong desire to achieve something.", trans: "Tham vá»ng: Mong muá»‘n máº¡nh máº½ Ä‘á»ƒ Ä‘áº¡t Ä‘Æ°á»£c Ä‘iá»u gÃ¬ Ä‘Ã³." },

            focus: { def: "Concentrated attention on a particular goal or task.", trans: "Sá»± táº­p trung: Sá»± chÃº Ã½ táº­p trung vÃ o má»™t má»¥c tiÃªu hoáº·c nhiá»‡m vá»¥ cá»¥ thá»ƒ." },

            hobby: { def: "An activity done regularly in one's leisure time for pleasure.", trans: "Sá»Ÿ thÃ­ch: Má»™t hoáº¡t Ä‘á»™ng Ä‘Æ°á»£c thá»±c hiá»‡n thÆ°á»ng xuyÃªn trong thá»i gian ráº£nh Ä‘á»ƒ giáº£i trÃ­." }

        };



        function createVocabList() {

            const container = document.getElementById('vocab-list-container');

            container.innerHTML = ''; 

            for (const [word, data] of Object.entries(vocabData)) {

                const item = document.createElement('div');

                item.className = 'vocab-item';

                item.textContent = word.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + word.slice(1); 

                item.setAttribute('role', 'button');

                item.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');

                

                const details = document.createElement('div');

                details.className = 'vocab-details';

                

                const definition = document.createElement('div');

                definition.className = 'definition';

                definition.textContent = 'ðŸ“– ' + data.def;

                definition.setAttribute('role', 'button');

                definition.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');

                

                const translation = document.createElement('div');

                translation.className = 'translation';

                translation.textContent = 'ðŸ‡»ðŸ‡³ ' + data.trans;

                

                definition.onclick = (e) => {

                    e.stopPropagation();

                    const isVisible = translation.style.display === 'block';

                    translation.style.display = isVisible ? 'none' : 'block';

                };

                

                definition.onkeypress = (e) => {

                    if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {

                        e.preventDefault();

                        definition.onclick(e);

                    }

                };

                

                details.appendChild(definition);

                details.appendChild(translation);

                item.appendChild(details);

                

                const toggleVocab = () => {

                    document.querySelectorAll('.vocab-item.active').forEach(activeItem => {

                        if(activeItem !== item) {

                            activeItem.classList.remove('active');

                            activeItem.querySelector('.translation').style.display = 'none';

                        }

                    });

                    item.classList.toggle('active');

                    if (!item.classList.contains('active')) {

                        translation.style.display = 'none';

                    }

                };

                

                item.onclick = toggleVocab;

                item.onkeypress = (e) => {

                    if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {

                        e.preventDefault();

                        toggleVocab();

                    }

                };

                

                container.appendChild(item);

            }

        }



        function showTip() {

            const tipEl = document.getElementById('tip');

            const tipButton = document.getElementById('tip-button');

            tipEl.style.display = 'block';

            tipEl.innerHTML = '<div class="tip-box"><strong>ðŸ’Ž Wisdom for Cultivating Passion:</strong><br><br>Find something you genuinely love and dedicate consistent time to it. Start with just 15 minutes daily. Small, regular actions build mastery and naturally ignite deeper passion. Remember: passion isn\'t foundâ€”it\'s developed through sustained engagement and curiosity.</div>';

            tipButton.disabled = true;

            tipButton.textContent = 'Wisdom Revealed âœ“';

            tipEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });

        }



        const writingInput = document.getElementById('writing-prompt-input');

        const wordCountEl = document.getElementById('word-count');

        

        writingInput.addEventListener('input', () => {

            const text = writingInput.value.trim();

            const wordCount = text.length > 0 ? text.split(/\s+/).length : 0;

            wordCountEl.textContent = wordCount + ' words';

            if (wordCount >= 20) {

                wordCountEl.classList.add('sufficient');

            } else {

                wordCountEl.classList.remove('sufficient');

            }

        });



        document.getElementById('writing-prompt-submit').onclick = () => {

            const input = document.getElementById('writing-prompt-input');

            const feedback = document.getElementById('writing-feedback');

            const text = input.value.trim();

            const wordCount = text.length > 0 ? text.split(/\s+/).length : 0;

            

            if (wordCount < 10) {

                feedback.textContent = "âš ï¸ Please provide a more detailed answer. Try to write at least 10 words to share your thoughts.";

                feedback.className = "feedback error";

            } else if (wordCount < 20) {

                feedback.textContent = "ðŸ“ Good start! Consider expanding your answer a bit more to fully explore the relationship between passion and ambition.";

                feedback.className = "feedback warning";

                if (!lessonProgress.writing) {

                    lessonProgress.writing = true;

                    updateLessonProgress();

                }

            } else {

                feedback.textContent = "âœ… Excellent reflection! Your thoughtful analysis demonstrates deep understanding of how internal passion drives external ambition. Your response has been logged.";

                feedback.className = "feedback success";

                if (!lessonProgress.writing) {

                    lessonProgress.writing = true;

                    updateLessonProgress();

                }

            }

            feedback.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });

        };



        class VocabScrambleGame {

            constructor(containerId, wordList, feedbackId, onSuccessCallback) {

                this.container = document.getElementById(containerId);

                this.feedbackEl = document.getElementById(feedbackId);

                this.wordList = this.shuffleArray([...wordList]);

                this.currentWordIndex = 0;

                this.attempts = 0;

                this.correctAnswers = 0;

                this.onSuccess = onSuccessCallback;

                this.init();

            }



            init() {

                this.container.innerHTML = '';

                this.setFeedback('');

                this.createScrambleUI();

            }



            shuffleArray(array) {

                for (let i = array.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {

                    const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));

                    [array[i], array[j]] = [array[j], array[i]];

                }

                return array;

            }



            scrambleWord(word) {

                if (word.length <= 2) return word.split('').reverse().join('');

                

                let scrambled;

                let attempts = 0;

                do {

                    const arr = word.split('');

                    for (let i = arr.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {

                        const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));

                        [arr[i], arr[j]] = [arr[j], arr[i]];

                    }

                    scrambled = arr.join('');

                    attempts++;

                } while (scrambled === word && attempts < 10);

                

                return scrambled;

            }



            setFeedback(message, className = '') {

                if (this.feedbackEl) {

                    this.feedbackEl.textContent = message;

                    this.feedbackEl.className = className ? 'feedback ' + className : 'feedback';

                }

            }



            createScrambleUI() {

                if (this.currentWordIndex >= this.wordList.length) {

                    this.container.innerHTML = '';

                    const accuracy = Math.round((this.correctAnswers / Math.max(1, this.attempts)) * 100);

                    this.setFeedback(`ðŸŽ‰ All words unscrambled! Accuracy: ${accuracy}% (${this.correctAnswers}/${this.attempts} attempts)`, 'success');

                    this.onSuccess(); 

                    return;

                }



                const word = this.wordList[this.currentWordIndex];

                const scrambled = this.scrambleWord(word);

                

                this.container.innerHTML = ''; 

                

                const progressText = document.createElement('p');

                progressText.style.color = 'var(--cyan)';

                progressText.style.fontSize = '0.9em';

                progressText.style.marginBottom = '0.5em';

                progressText.textContent = `Progress: ${this.currentWordIndex + 1} / ${this.wordList.length}`;

                

                const prompt = document.createElement('p');

                prompt.textContent = `Unscramble this word: "${scrambled}"`;

                prompt.style.color = 'var(--gold)';

                prompt.style.fontSize = '1.3em';

                prompt.style.fontWeight = 'bold';

                prompt.style.margin = '1em 0';

                

                const hintText = document.createElement('p');

                hintText.style.color = 'var(--text-light)';

                hintText.style.fontSize = '0.9em';

                hintText.style.fontStyle = 'italic';

                hintText.textContent = `Hint: This is a vocabulary word from the lesson (${word.length} letters)`;

                

                const input = document.createElement('input');

                input.type = 'text';

                input.id = 'scramble-input';

                input.placeholder = 'Type the unscrambled word...';

                input.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Unscrambled word input');

                input.style.textTransform = 'lowercase';

                

                const button = document.createElement('button');

                button.textContent = 'Submit Answer';

                button.style.marginRight = '0.5em';

                

                const skipButton = document.createElement('button');

                skipButton.textContent = 'Skip Word';

                skipButton.style.background = 'linear-gradient(135deg, #333 0%, #555 100%)';

                skipButton.onclick = () => {

                    this.setFeedback(`â­ï¸ Skipped "${word}". Moving to next word...`, 'warning');

                    this.currentWordIndex++;

                    setTimeout(() => this.createScrambleUI(), 800);

                };

                

                const submitAnswer = () => this.checkAnswer(input.value);

                button.onclick = submitAnswer;

                input.onkeypress = (e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') submitAnswer(); };

                

                this.container.appendChild(progressText);

                this.container.appendChild(prompt);

                this.container.appendChild(hintText);

                this.container.appendChild(input);

                

                const buttonContainer = document.createElement('div');

                buttonContainer.appendChild(button);

                buttonContainer.appendChild(skipButton);

                this.container.appendChild(buttonContainer);

                

                input.focus();

            }



            checkAnswer(answer) {

                this.attempts++;

                const correctWord = this.wordList[this.currentWordIndex];

                if (answer.toLowerCase().trim() === correctWord.toLowerCase()) {

                    this.correctAnswers++;

                    this.setFeedback(`âœ… Correct! "${correctWord}" is right!`, 'success');

                    this.currentWordIndex++;

                    setTimeout(() => this.createScrambleUI(), 1000);

                } else {

                    if (answer.trim().length === 0) {

                        this.setFeedback('âŒ Please enter an answer.', 'error');

                    } else {

                        this.setFeedback(`âŒ Not quite. "${answer}" is incorrect. Try again!`, 'error');

                    }

                    const inputEl = document.getElementById('scramble-input');

                    if(inputEl) { 

                        inputEl.focus(); 

                        inputEl.select(); 

                    }

                }

            }

        }



        class DefinitionMatchGame {

            constructor(containerId, vocab, feedbackId, onSuccessCallback) {

                this.container = document.getElementById(containerId);

                this.feedbackEl = document.getElementById(feedbackId);

                this.vocab = vocab;

                this.onSuccess = onSuccessCallback;

                this.words = Object.keys(vocab);

                this.definitions = this.words.map(word => ({ word, def: vocab[word].def }));

                this.selectedWord = null;

                this.selectedDef = null;

                this.matchedPairs = 0;

                this.attempts = 0;

                this.correctMatches = 0;

                this.init();

            }



            shuffleArray(array) {

                const newArray = [...array];

                for (let i = newArray.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {

                    const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));

                    [newArray[i], newArray[j]] = [newArray[j], newArray[i]];

                }

                return newArray;

            }



            setFeedback(message, className = '') {

                if (this.feedbackEl) {

                    this.feedbackEl.textContent = message;

                    this.feedbackEl.className = className ? 'feedback ' + className : 'feedback';

                }

            }



            init() {

                this.container.innerHTML = '';

                this.setFeedback('ðŸŽ¯ Match each word to its definition. Select one word and one definition to make a pair.');

                

                const gameBox = document.createElement('div');

                gameBox.className = 'match-game-container';

                

                const wordCol = document.createElement('div');

                wordCol.className = 'match-col';

                const wordHeader = document.createElement('div');

                wordHeader.className = 'match-col-header';

                wordHeader.textContent = 'ðŸ“ WORDS';

                wordCol.appendChild(wordHeader);

                

                const defCol = document.createElement('div');

                defCol.className = 'match-col';

                const defHeader = document.createElement('div');

                defHeader.className = 'match-col-header';

                defHeader.textContent = 'ðŸ“– DEFINITIONS';

                defCol.appendChild(defHeader);

                

                const shuffledWords = this.shuffleArray([...this.words]);

                const shuffledDefs = this.shuffleArray([...this.definitions]);

                

                shuffledWords.forEach(word => {

                    const el = document.createElement('div');

                    el.className = 'match-item';

                    el.textContent = word.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + word.slice(1);

                    el.dataset.word = word;

                    el.setAttribute('role', 'button');

                    el.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');

                    el.onclick = () => this.selectWord(el);

                    el.onkeypress = (e) => {

                        if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {

                            e.preventDefault();

                            this.selectWord(el);

                        }

                    };

                    wordCol.appendChild(el);

                });

                

                shuffledDefs.forEach(defObj => {

                    const el = document.createElement('div');

                    el.className = 'match-item';

                    el.textContent = defObj.def;

                    el.dataset.def = defObj.def;

                    el.dataset.word = defObj.word;

                    el.setAttribute('role', 'button');

                    el.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');

                    el.onclick = () => this.selectDef(el);

                    el.onkeypress = (e) => {

                        if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {

                            e.preventDefault();

                            this.selectDef(el);

                        }

                    };

                    defCol.appendChild(el);

                });

                

                gameBox.appendChild(wordCol);

                gameBox.appendChild(defCol);

                this.container.appendChild(gameBox);

                

                const statsBox = document.createElement('div');

                statsBox.style.marginTop = '1em';

                statsBox.style.padding = '1em';

                statsBox.style.background = 'rgba(157, 0, 255, 0.1)';

                statsBox.style.borderRadius = '8px';

                statsBox.style.textAlign = 'center';

                statsBox.id = 'match-stats';

                statsBox.innerHTML = `<strong>Progress:</strong> ${this.matchedPairs} / ${this.words.length} pairs matched`;

                this.container.appendChild(statsBox);

            }



            updateStats() {

                const statsBox = document.getElementById('match-stats');

                if (statsBox) {

                    const accuracy = this.attempts > 0 ? Math.round((this.correctMatches / this.attempts) * 100) : 0;

                    statsBox.innerHTML = `<strong>Progress:</strong> ${this.matchedPairs} / ${this.words.length} pairs | <strong>Accuracy:</strong> ${accuracy}%`;

                }

            }



            selectWord(el) {

                if (el.classList.contains('matched')) return;

                document.querySelectorAll('.match-item[data-word]').forEach(item => {

                    if (item !== el) item.classList.remove('selected');

                });

                

                if (this.selectedWord === el) {

                    el.classList.remove('selected');

                    this.selectedWord = null;

                } else {

                    el.classList.add('selected');

                    this.selectedWord = el;

                }

                this.checkMatch();

            }



            selectDef(el) {

                if (el.classList.contains('matched')) return;

                document.querySelectorAll('.match-item[data-def]').forEach(item => {

                    if (item !== el) item.classList.remove('selected');

                });

                

                if (this.selectedDef === el) {

                    el.classList.remove('selected');

                    this.selectedDef = null;

                } else {

                    el.classList.add('selected');

                    this.selectedDef = el;

                }

                this.checkMatch();

            }



            checkMatch() {

                if (!this.selectedWord || !this.selectedDef) return;

                

                this.attempts++;

                const word = this.selectedWord.dataset.word;

                const defWord = this.selectedDef.dataset.word;

                

                if (word === defWord) {

                    this.correctMatches++;

                    this.setFeedback(`âœ… Perfect match! "${word.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + word.slice(1)}" is correctly paired!`, 'success');

                    this.selectedWord.classList.add('matched');

                    this.selectedDef.classList.add('matched');

                    this.selectedWord.classList.remove('selected');

                    this.selectedDef.classList.remove('selected');

                    this.matchedPairs++;

                } else {

                    this.setFeedback(`âŒ Not a match. "${word.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + word.slice(1)}" doesn't match that definition. Try again!`, 'error');

                    this.selectedWord.classList.remove('selected');

                    this.selectedDef.classList.remove('selected');

                }

                

                this.selectedWord = null;

                this.selectedDef = null;

                this.updateStats();

                

                if (this.matchedPairs === this.words.length) {

                    const accuracy = Math.round((this.correctMatches / this.attempts) * 100);

                    this.setFeedback(`ðŸŽ‰ All definitions matched! Final accuracy: ${accuracy}%`, 'success');

                    this.onSuccess();

                }

            }

        }



        window.onload = () => {

            const vocabList = Object.keys(vocabData);

            

            createVocabList();

            

            new VocabScrambleGame(

                'gameContainer1',

                vocabList.slice(0, 5),

                'game-feedback-1',

                () => {

                    const completeEl = document.getElementById('mission-complete-1');

                    completeEl.style.display = 'block';

                    completeEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });

                    if (!lessonProgress.game1) {

                        lessonProgress.game1 = true;

                        updateLessonProgress();

                    }

                }

            );

            

            const matchVocab = {};

            vocabList.slice(5).forEach(word => {

                matchVocab[word] = vocabData[word];

            });

            new DefinitionMatchGame(

                'gameContainer2',

                matchVocab,

                'game-feedback-2',

                () => {

                    const completeEl = document.getElementById('mission-complete-2');

                    completeEl.style.display = 'block';

                    completeEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });

                    if (!lessonProgress.game2) {

                        lessonProgress.game2 = true;

                        updateLessonProgress();

                    }

                }

            );

            

            updateLessonProgress();

        };

    </script>

</body>

</html>

Here is the remade lesson, fully converted to an E4 (Late Beginner) level.

I've kept your excellent HTML structure and CSS, but I've completely replaced the content to be simple, accessible, and concrete. The theme is now "My Favorite Hobby" and all games and readings are updated and functional.

HTML
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Lesson: My Favorite Hobby (E4 Beginner)</title>
    <style>
        :root {
            --bg-dark: #05020D;
            --purple-dark: #1B0A3A;
            --purple-bright: #9D00FF;
            --gold: #FFD700;
            --cyan: #00FFAA;
            --text-light: #E0E0E0;
            --text-dark: #05020D;
            --danger: #FF4500;
            --success: #00FFAA;
            --warning: #FFA500;
        }
        * {
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }
        body {
            font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--bg-dark) 0%, #0a0420 100%);
            color: var(--gold);
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            min-height: 100vh;
        }
        header {
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--purple-dark) 0%, #2a0a5a 100%);
            color: var(--cyan);
            text-align: center;
            padding: 1.5em 1em;
            border-bottom: 3px solid var(--purple-bright);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(157, 0, 255, 0.3);
        }
        header h1 {
            margin: 0;
            font-size: 2em;
            text-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--cyan);
        }
        main {
            padding: 2em;
            max-width: 1000px;
            margin: auto;
        }
        h1 { color: var(--cyan); }
        h2 {
            color: var(--gold);
            border-bottom: 2px solid var(--purple-bright);
            padding-bottom: 8px;
            margin-top: 2em;
            font-size: 1.6em;
        }
        h3 {
            color: var(--cyan);
            margin-top: 0;
        }
        p {
            font-size: 1.1em;
            line-height: 1.7em;
            color: var(--text-light);
        }
        .progress-container {
            width: 100%;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--purple-dark) 0%, #1a0a30 100%);
            border-radius: 10px;
            border: 2px solid var(--purple-bright);
            margin-bottom: 1.5em;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(157, 0, 255, 0.2);
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .progress-bar {
            width: 0%;
            height: 30px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--cyan) 0%, #00cc88 100%);
            border-radius: 8px;
            text-align: center;
            line-height: 30px;
            color: var(--text-dark);
            font-weight: bold;
            transition: width 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
            box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0, 255, 170, 0.5);
        }
        .progress-stats {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-around;
            margin-top: 1em;
            padding: 1em;
            background: rgba(27, 10, 58, 0.5);
            border-radius: 8px;
            border: 1px solid var(--purple-bright);
        }
        .stat-item {
            text-align: center;
        }
        .stat-label {
            font-size: 0.9em;
            color: var(--text-light);
            margin-bottom: 0.3em;
        }
        .stat-value {
            font-size: 1.5em;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: var(--cyan);
        }
        .stat-item.completed .stat-value {
            color: var(--success);
        }
        #global-mission-complete {
            display: none;
            font-size: 2.5em;
            text-align: center;
            padding: 1.5em;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple-bright) 0%, var(--gold) 100%);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
            animation: pulse 2s infinite, shimmer 3s infinite;
            font-weight: 900;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
        }
        .vocab-list {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr));
            gap: 1em;
            margin-top: 1em;
        }
        .vocab-item {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple-dark) 0%, #1a0a40 100%);
            padding: 1em;
            border-radius: 8px;
            font-weight: bold;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
            border: 2px solid var(--purple-bright);
            text-align: center;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        .vocab-item::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: -100%;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(157, 0, 255, 0.3), transparent);
            transition: left 0.5s;
        }
        .vocab-item:hover::before {
            left: 100%;
        }
        .vocab-item:hover {
            transform: translateY(-5px) scale(1.02);
            box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(157, 0, 255, 0.5);
            border-color: var(--cyan);
        }
        .vocab-details {
            display: none; 
            margin-top: 0.75em;
            padding: 0.75em;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
            border-radius: 6px;
            text-align: left;
            border-left: 3px solid var(--cyan);
        }
        .vocab-details .definition {
            font-style: italic;
            color: var(--text-light);
            font-weight: normal;
            cursor: pointer;
            padding: 0.5em;
            border-radius: 4px;
            transition: background-color 0.2s;
        }
        .vocab-details .definition:hover {
            color: var(--cyan);
            background: rgba(157, 0, 255, 0.2);
        }
        .vocab-details .translation {
            display: none;
            font-style: normal;
            color: var(--cyan);
            font-weight: bold;
            margin-top: 0.5em;
            padding: 0.5em;
            background: rgba(0, 255, 170, 0.1);
            border-radius: 4px;
            animation: fadeIn 0.3s;
        }
        .vocab-item.active {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple-bright) 0%, #7700cc 100%);
            box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(157, 0, 255, 0.7);
        }
        .vocab-item.active .vocab-details {
            display: block;
            animation: slideDown 0.3s;
        }
        .module-container {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0a0420 0%, #1a0a40 100%);
            padding: 2em;
            margin-top: 1.5em;
            border-radius: 12px;
            border-left: 6px solid var(--purple-bright);
            box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
            position: relative;
        }
        .module-container::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            right: 0;
            width: 100px;
            height: 100px;
            background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(157, 0, 255, 0.1) 0%, transparent 70%);
            pointer-events: none;
        }
        button {
            margin-top: 1em;
            padding: 0.8em 1.5em;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple-bright) 0%, #7700cc 100%);
            color: white;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 8px;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-weight: bold;
            font-size: 1em;
            transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(157, 0, 255, 0.4);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        button::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: 50%;
            left: 50%;
            width: 0;
            height: 0;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
            transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
            transition: width 0.6s, height 0.6s;
        }
        button:hover::before {
            width: 300px;
            height: 300px;
        }
        button:hover {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--cyan) 0%, #00cc88 100%);
            color: var(--text-dark);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 0 6px 25px rgba(0, 255, 170, 0.6);
        }
        button:active {
            transform: translateY(0) scale(0.98);
        }
        button:disabled {
            background: #333;
            cursor: not-allowed;
            box-shadow: none;
            opacity: 0.5;
        }
        input[type="text"], textarea {
            padding: 0.75em;
            border-radius: 8px;
            border: 2px solid var(--purple-bright);
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--bg-dark) 0%, #0a0420 100%);
            color: var(--gold);
            font-size: 1em;
            margin: 0.5em 0;
            width: 100%;
            transition: all 0.3s;
        }
        textarea {
            min-height: 100px;
            font-family: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif;
            resize: vertical;
        }
        input[type="text"]:focus, textarea:focus {
            outline: none;
            border-color: var(--cyan);
            box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0, 255, 170, 0.4);
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0a0420 0%, #1a0a40 100%);
        }
        .feedback {
            margin-top: 1em;
            font-style: italic;
            font-weight: bold;
            min-height: 1.5em;
            padding: 0.75em;
            border-radius: 6px;
            transition: all 0.3s;
        }
        .feedback.success { 
            color: var(--success);
            background: rgba(0, 255, 170, 0.1);
            border-left: 4px solid var(--success);
        }
        .feedback.error { 
            color: var(--danger);
            background: rgba(255, 69, 0, 0.1);
            border-left: 4px solid var(--danger);
        }
        .feedback.warning {
            color: var(--warning);
            background: rgba(255, 165, 0, 0.1);
            border-left: 4px solid var(--warning);
        }
        .mission-complete {
            display: none;
            font-size: 2em;
            color: var(--success);
            text-align: center;
            padding: 2em;
            font-weight: bold;
            animation: pulse 1.5s infinite, confetti 0.5s;
            text-shadow: 0 0 15px var(--success);
        }
        .match-game-container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 1.5em;
        }
        .match-col {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0.75em;
        }
        .match-col-header {
            font-weight: bold;
            font-size: 1.1em;
            color: var(--cyan);
            text-align: center;
            padding: 0.5em;
            background: rgba(157, 0, 255, 0.2);
            border-radius: 6px;
            margin-bottom: 0.5em;
        }
        .match-item {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple-dark) 0%, #1a0a40 100%);
            border: 2px solid var(--purple-bright);
            padding: 1em;
            border-radius: 8px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
            min-height: 50px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            text-align: center;
        }
        .match-item:hover:not(.matched) {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple-bright) 0%, #7700cc 100%);
            transform: translateX(5px);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(157, 0, 255, 0.5);
        }
        .match-item.selected {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gold) 0%, #ffed4e 100%);
            color: var(--text-dark);
            border-color: var(--gold);
            transform: scale(1.05);
            box-shadow: 0 6px 25px rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.6);
            font-weight: bold;
        }
        .match-item.matched {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1a1a 0%, #2a2a2a 100%);
            color: #666;
            border-color: #333;
            cursor: not-allowed;
            opacity: 0.5;
            transform: scale(0.95);
        }
        .word-count {
            font-size: 0.9em;
            color: var(--text-light);
            margin-top: 0.5em;
            text-align: right;
        }
        .word-count.sufficient {
            color: var(--success);
        }
        .tip-box {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(157, 0, 255, 0.2) 0%, rgba(0, 255, 170, 0.2) 100%);
            padding: 1.5em;
            border-radius: 10px;
            border: 2px solid var(--cyan);
            margin-top: 1em;
            box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(0, 255, 170, 0.3);
        }
        @keyframes pulse {
            0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0.8; }
            50% { transform: scale(1.05); opacity: 1; }
        }
        @keyframes shimmer {
            0% { background-position: -1000px 0; }
            100% { background-position: 1000px 0; }
        }
        @keyframes fadeIn {
            from { opacity: 0; }
            to { opacity: 1; }
        }
        @keyframes slideDown {
            from { 
                opacity: 0;
                transform: translateY(-10px);
            }
            to { 
                opacity: 1;
                transform: translateY(0);
            }
        }
        @keyframes confetti {
            0% { transform: scale(0.5) rotate(-45deg); }
            50% { transform: scale(1.2) rotate(45deg); }
            100% { transform: scale(1) rotate(0deg); }
        }
        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            main {
                padding: 1em;
            }
            .vocab-list {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
            .match-game-container {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
            header h1 {
                font-size: 1.5em;
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <header>
        <h1>ðŸ“š Beginner English: My Favorite Hobby (E4)</h1>
    </header>
    <main>
        <section>
            <h2>ðŸ“Š Your Progress</h2>
            <div class="progress-container">
                <div class="progress-bar" id="lesson-progress-bar">0%</div>
            </div>
            <div class="progress-stats">
                <div class="stat-item" id="stat-game1">
                    <div class="stat-label">Game 1</div>
                    <div class="stat-value">â—‹</div>
                </div>
                <div class="stat-item" id="stat-game2">
                    <div class="stat-label">Game 2</div>
                    <div class="stat-value">â—‹</div>
                </div>
                <div class="stat-item" id="stat-writing">
                    <div class="stat-label">Writing</div>
                    <div class="stat-value">â—‹</div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div id="global-mission-complete" class="mission-complete">
                ðŸŽ‰ LESSON COMPLETE! GOOD JOB! ðŸŽ‰
            </div>
        </section>

        <section>
            <h2>ðŸ“– Lesson Overview</h2>
            <p>
                Hello! Welcome to our lesson. Today, we will talk about hobbies. A <strong>hobby</strong> is something you like to do in your free time.
            </p>
            <p>
                We will learn 10 new words. We will <strong>play</strong> games and <strong>read</strong> a short story. Let's have fun and learn English!
            </p>
        </section>

        <section>
            <h2>ðŸ“š Key Vocabulary</h2>
            <p style="color: var(--text-light); font-style: italic;">Click on a word to see the meaning. Click the meaning to see the Vietnamese translation.</p>
            <div class="vocab-list" id="vocab-list-container">
                </div>
        </section>

        <section>
            <h2>âœï¸ Short Reading & Writing</h2>
            <div class="module-container">
                <h3>My Favorite Hobby</h3>
                <p>
                    My name is Lan. I have a fun <strong>hobby</strong>. I like to <strong>draw</strong> pictures of my cat. I also <strong>read</strong> many books.
                    My brother likes to <strong>play</strong> sports. His favorite <strong>sport</strong> is football.
                    At night, we listen to <strong>music</strong>. My mom can <strong>sing</strong> very well. My dad likes to <strong>cook</strong> dinner for us.
                    We are a <strong>happy</strong> family.
                </p>
                
                <strong style="color: var(--cyan);">Your Turn:</strong>
                <p>What is your favorite <strong>hobby</strong>? What do you like to <strong>play</strong> or <strong>do</strong>? (Write 15 words or more).</p>
                
                <textarea id="writing-prompt-input" rows="5" placeholder="Type your answer here..." aria-label="Writing prompt answer"></textarea>
                <div class="word-count" id="word-count">0 words</div>
                <button id="writing-prompt-submit">Submit Writing</button>
                <div id="writing-feedback" class="feedback" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>
            </div>
        </section>

        <section>
            <h2>ðŸŽ® Game Module 1: Vocab Scramble</h2>
            <p style="color: var(--text-light); font-style: italic;">Put the letters in the correct order to make a word. Complete 5 words to finish.</p>
            <div class="module-container" id="gameContainer1">
                </div>
            <div id="game-feedback-1" class="feedback" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>
            <div id="mission-complete-1" class="mission-complete">
                âœ… MODULE 1 COMPLETE!
            </div>
        </section>

        <section>
            <h2>ðŸ§© Game Module 2: Definition Match</h2>
            <p style="color: var(--text-light); font-style: italic;">Match the word to its meaning. Select one word and one meaning to make a pair.</p>
            <div class="module-container" id="gameContainer2">
                </div>
            <div id="game-feedback-2" class="feedback" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>
            <div id="mission-complete-2" class="mission-complete">
                âœ… MODULE 2 COMPLETE!
            </div>
        </section>

        <section>
            <h2>ðŸ’¡ Quick Tip</h2>
            <p>Discover a simple tip to practice English every day:</p>
            <button onclick="showTip()" id="tip-button">Show Tip</button>
            <div id="tip" class="feedback success" style="display: none;"></div>
        </section>
    </main>
    <script>
        const lessonProgress = {
            game1: false,
            game2: false,
            writing: false,
            totalTasks: 3
        };

        function updateLessonProgress() {
            let completedTasks = 0;
            if (lessonProgress.game1) completedTasks++;
            if (lessonProgress.game2) completedTasks++;
            if (lessonProgress.writing) completedTasks++;
            
            const percentage = Math.round((completedTasks / lessonProgress.totalTasks) * 100);
            const progressBar = document.getElementById('lesson-progress-bar');
            
            progressBar.style.width = percentage + '%';
            progressBar.textContent = percentage + '%';
            
            document.getElementById('stat-game1').classList.toggle('completed', lessonProgress.game1);
            document.getElementById('stat-game1').querySelector('.stat-value').textContent = lessonProgress.game1 ? 'âœ“' : 'â—‹';
            
            document.getElementById('stat-game2').classList.toggle('completed', lessonProgress.game2);
            document.getElementById('stat-game2').querySelector('.stat-value').textContent = lessonProgress.game2 ? 'âœ“' : 'â—‹';
            
            document.getElementById('stat-writing').classList.toggle('completed', lessonProgress.writing);
            document.getElementById('stat-writing').querySelector('.stat-value').textContent = lessonProgress.writing ? 'âœ“' : 'â—‹';
            
            if (percentage === 100) {
                document.getElementById('global-mission-complete').style.display = 'block';
                progressBar.style.background = 'linear-gradient(90deg, var(--gold) 0%, var(--cyan) 100%)';
                document.getElementById('global-mission-complete').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
            }
        }

        // E4 Version: New Vocabulary List
        const vocabData = {
            hobby: { def: "An activity you do for fun in your free time.", trans: "Sá»Ÿ thÃ­ch: Má»™t hoáº¡t Ä‘á»™ng báº¡n lÃ m Ä‘á»ƒ giáº£i trÃ­ trong thá»i gian ráº£nh." },
            play: { def: "To do an activity for fun or to do a sport.", trans: "ChÆ¡i: Thá»±c hiá»‡n má»™t hoáº¡t Ä‘á»™ng Ä‘á»ƒ giáº£i trÃ­ hoáº·c chÆ¡i má»™t mÃ´n thá»ƒ thao." },
            draw: { def: "To make a picture with a pen or pencil.", trans: "Váº½: Táº¡o ra má»™t bá»©c tranh báº±ng bÃºt má»±c hoáº·c bÃºt chÃ¬." },
            read: { def: "To look at and understand words in a book or online.", trans: "Äá»c: NhÃ¬n vÃ  hiá»ƒu cÃ¡c tá»« trong sÃ¡ch hoáº·c trÃªn máº¡ng." },
            music: { def: "Sounds put together in a nice way, like a song.", trans: "Ã‚m nháº¡c: Nhá»¯ng Ã¢m thanh Ä‘Æ°á»£c káº¿t há»£p láº¡i má»™t cÃ¡ch hay, giá»‘ng nhÆ° má»™t bÃ i hÃ¡t." },
            game: { def: "An activity with rules that you play for fun.", trans: "TrÃ² chÆ¡i: Má»™t hoáº¡t Ä‘á»™ng cÃ³ luáº­t lá»‡ mÃ  báº¡n chÆ¡i Ä‘á»ƒ giáº£i trÃ­." },
            sing: { def: "To make music sounds with your voice.", trans: "HÃ¡t: Táº¡o ra Ã¢m thanh Ã¢m nháº¡c báº±ng giá»ng nÃ³i cá»§a báº¡n." },
            cook: { def: "To make food ready to eat, using heat.", trans: "Náº¥u Äƒn: Chuáº©n bá»‹ thá»©c Äƒn Ä‘á»ƒ Äƒn, sá»­ dá»¥ng nhiá»‡t." },
            sport: { def: "A game like football, basketball, or swimming.", trans: "Thá»ƒ thao: Má»™t trÃ² chÆ¡i nhÆ° bÃ³ng Ä‘Ã¡, bÃ³ng rá»•, hoáº·c bÆ¡i lá»™i." },
            happy: { def: "Feeling good or pleased.", trans: "Vui váº»: Cáº£m tháº¥y tá»‘t hoáº·c hÃ i lÃ²ng." }
        };

        function createVocabList() {
            const container = document.getElementById('vocab-list-container');
            container.innerHTML = ''; 
            for (const [word, data] of Object.entries(vocabData)) {
                const item = document.createElement('div');
                item.className = 'vocab-item';
                item.textContent = word.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + word.slice(1); 
                item.setAttribute('role', 'button');
                item.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
                
                const details = document.createElement('div');
                details.className = 'vocab-details';
                
                const definition = document.createElement('div');
                definition.className = 'definition';
                definition.textContent = 'ðŸ“– ' + data.def;
                definition.setAttribute('role', 'button');
                definition.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
                
                const translation = document.createElement('div');
                translation.className = 'translation';
                translation.textContent = 'ðŸ‡»ðŸ‡³ ' + data.trans;
                
                definition.onclick = (e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    const isVisible = translation.style.display === 'block';
                    translation.style.display = isVisible ? 'none' : 'block';
                };
                
                definition.onkeypress = (e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        definition.onclick(e);
                    }
                };
                
                details.appendChild(definition);
                details.appendChild(translation);
                item.appendChild(details);
                
                const toggleVocab = () => {
                    document.querySelectorAll('.vocab-item.active').forEach(activeItem => {
                        if(activeItem !== item) {
                            activeItem.classList.remove('active');
                            activeItem.querySelector('.translation').style.display = 'none';
                        }
                    });
                    item.classList.toggle('active');
                    if (!item.classList.contains('active')) {
                        translation.style.display = 'none';
                    }
                };
                
                item.onclick = toggleVocab;
                item.onkeypress = (e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        toggleVocab();
                    }
                };
                
                container.appendChild(item);
            }
        }

        // E4 Version: Simplified Tip
        function showTip() {
            const tipEl = document.getElementById('tip');
            const tipButton = document.getElementById('tip-button');
            tipEl.style.display = 'block';
            tipEl.innerHTML = '<div class="tip-box"><strong>ðŸ’¡ Simple Tip:</strong><br><br>Try to learn just 3 new English words every day. You can write them in a small notebook. This is a great way to build your vocabulary!</div>';
            tipButton.disabled = true;
            tipButton.textContent = 'Tip Shown âœ“';
            tipEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
        }

        const writingInput = document.getElementById('writing-prompt-input');
        const wordCountEl = document.getElementById('word-count');
        
        writingInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
            const text = writingInput.value.trim();
            const wordCount = text.length > 0 ? text.split(/\s+/).length : 0;
            wordCountEl.textContent = wordCount + ' words';
            // E4 Version: Changed to 15 words
            if (wordCount >= 15) {
                wordCountEl.classList.add('sufficient');
            } else {
                wordCountEl.classList.remove('sufficient');
            }
        });

        document.getElementById('writing-prompt-submit').onclick = () => {
            const input = document.getElementById('writing-prompt-input');
            const feedback = document.getElementById('writing-feedback');
            const text = input.value.trim();
            const wordCount = text.length > 0 ? text.split(/\s+/).length : 0;
            
            // E4 Version: Simplified feedback and word count
            if (wordCount < 5) {
                feedback.textContent = "âš ï¸ Please write a little more. Try to write at least 5 words.";
                feedback.className = "feedback error";
            } else if (wordCount < 15) {
                feedback.textContent = "ðŸ“ Good start! Try to write 15 words or more to pass this task.";
                feedback.className = "feedback warning";
            } else {
                feedback.textContent = "âœ… Great job! Your writing is good. Task complete!";
                feedback.className = "feedback success";
                if (!lessonProgress.writing) {
                    lessonProgress.writing = true;
                    updateLessonProgress();
                }
            }
            feedback.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
        };

        // --- Game 1: Vocab Scramble ---
        class VocabScrambleGame {
            constructor(containerId, wordList, feedbackId, onSuccessCallback) {
                this.container = document.getElementById(containerId);
                this.feedbackEl = document.getElementById(feedbackId);
                this.wordList = this.shuffleArray([...wordList]);
                this.currentWordIndex = 0;
                this.attempts = 0;
                this.correctAnswers = 0;
                this.onSuccess = onSuccessCallback;
                this.init();
            }

            init() {
                this.container.innerHTML = '';
                this.setFeedback('');
                this.createScrambleUI();
            }

            shuffleArray(array) {
                for (let i = array.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
                    const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
                    [array[i], array[j]] = [array[j], array[i]];
                }
                return array;
            }

            scrambleWord(word) {
                if (word.length <= 2) return word.split('').reverse().join('');
                
                let scrambled;
                let attempts = 0;
                do {
                    const arr = word.split('');
                    for (let i = arr.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
                        const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
                        [arr[i], arr[j]] = [arr[j], arr[i]];
                    }
                    scrambled = arr.join('');
                    attempts++;
                } while (scrambled === word && attempts < 10);
                
                return scrambled;
            }

            setFeedback(message, className = '') {
                if (this.feedbackEl) {
                    this.feedbackEl.textContent = message;
                    this.feedbackEl.className = className ? 'feedback ' + className : 'feedback';
                }
            }

            createScrambleUI() {
                if (this.currentWordIndex >= this.wordList.length) {
                    this.container.innerHTML = '';
                    const accuracy = Math.round((this.correctAnswers / Math.max(1, this.attempts)) * 100);
                    this.setFeedback(`ðŸŽ‰ All words finished! Your accuracy: ${accuracy}%`, 'success');
                    this.onSuccess(); 
                    return;
                }

                const word = this.wordList[this.currentWordIndex];
                const scrambled = this.scrambleWord(word);
                
                this.container.innerHTML = ''; 
                
                const progressText = document.createElement('p');
                progressText.style.color = 'var(--cyan)';
                progressText.style.fontSize = '0.9em';
                progressText.style.marginBottom = '0.5em';
                progressText.textContent = `Word: ${this.currentWordIndex + 1} / ${this.wordList.length}`;
                
                const prompt = document.createElement('p');
                prompt.textContent = `Unscramble this word: "${scrambled}"`;
                prompt.style.color = 'var(--gold)';
                prompt.style.fontSize = '1.3em';
                prompt.style.fontWeight = 'bold';
                prompt.style.margin = '1em 0';
                
                const hintText = document.createElement('p');
                hintText.style.color = 'var(--text-light)';
                hintText.style.fontSize = '0.9em';
                hintText.style.fontStyle = 'italic';
                hintText.textContent = `Hint: It is a word from our list (${word.length} letters)`;
                
                const input = document.createElement('input');
                input.type = 'text';
                input.id = 'scramble-input';
                input.placeholder = 'Type the unscrambled word...';
                input.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Unscrambled word input');
                input.style.textTransform = 'lowercase';
                
                const button = document.createElement('button');
                button.textContent = 'Submit Answer';
                button.style.marginRight = '0.5em';
                
                const skipButton = document.createElement('button');
                skipButton.textContent = 'Skip Word';
                skipButton.style.background = 'linear-gradient(135deg, #333 0%, #555 100%)';
                skipButton.onclick = () => {
                    this.setFeedback(`â­ï¸ Skipped "${word}". Moving to next word...`, 'warning');
                    this.currentWordIndex++;
                    setTimeout(() => this.createScrambleUI(), 800);
                };
                
                const submitAnswer = () => this.checkAnswer(input.value);
                button.onclick = submitAnswer;
                input.onkeypress = (e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter') submitAnswer(); };
                
                this.container.appendChild(progressText);
                this.container.appendChild(prompt);
                this.container.appendChild(hintText);
                this.container.appendChild(input);
                
                const buttonContainer = document.createElement('div');
                buttonContainer.appendChild(button);
                buttonContainer.appendChild(skipButton);
                this.container.appendChild(buttonContainer);
                
                input.focus();
            }

            checkAnswer(answer) {
                this.attempts++;
                const correctWord = this.wordList[this.currentWordIndex];
                if (answer.toLowerCase().trim() === correctWord.toLowerCase()) {
                    this.correctAnswers++;
                    this.setFeedback(`âœ… Correct! "${correctWord}" is right!`, 'success');
                    this.currentWordIndex++;
                    setTimeout(() => this.createScrambleUI(), 1000);
                } else {
                    if (answer.trim().length === 0) {
                        this.setFeedback('âŒ Please enter an answer.', 'error');
                    } else {
                        this.setFeedback(`âŒ Not quite. "${answer}" is incorrect. Try again!`, 'error');
                    }
                    const inputEl = document.getElementById('scramble-input');
                    if(inputEl) { 
                        inputEl.focus(); 
                        inputEl.select(); 
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // --- Game 2: Definition Match ---
        class DefinitionMatchGame {
            constructor(containerId, vocab, feedbackId, onSuccessCallback) {
                this.container = document.getElementById(containerId);
                this.feedbackEl = document.getElementById(feedbackId);
                this.vocab = vocab;
                this.onSuccess = onSuccessCallback;
                this.words = Object.keys(vocab);
                this.definitions = this.words.map(word => ({ word, def: vocab[word].def }));
                this.selectedWord = null;
                this.selectedDef = null;
                this.matchedPairs = 0;
                this.attempts = 0;
                this.correctMatches = 0;
                this.init();
            }

            shuffleArray(array) {
                const newArray = [...array];
                for (let i = newArray.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
                    const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
                    [newArray[i], newArray[j]] = [newArray[j], newArray[i]];
                }
                return newArray;
            }

            setFeedback(message, className = '') {
                if (this.feedbackEl) {
                    this.feedbackEl.textContent = message;
                    this.feedbackEl.className = className ? 'feedback ' + className : 'feedback';
                }
            }

            init() {
                this.container.innerHTML = '';
                this.setFeedback('ðŸŽ¯ Match each word to its meaning. Select one word and one meaning.');
                
                const gameBox = document.createElement('div');
                gameBox.className = 'match-game-container';
                
                const wordCol = document.createElement('div');
                wordCol.className = 'match-col';
                const wordHeader = document.createElement('div');
                wordHeader.className = 'match-col-header';
                wordHeader.textContent = 'ðŸ“ WORDS';
                wordCol.appendChild(wordHeader);
                
                const defCol = document.createElement('div');
                defCol.className = 'match-col';
                const defHeader = document.createElement('div');
                defHeader.className = 'match-col-header';
                defHeader.textContent = 'ðŸ“– MEANINGS';
                defCol.appendChild(defHeader);
                
                const shuffledWords = this.shuffleArray([...this.words]);
                const shuffledDefs = this.shuffleArray([...this.definitions]);
                
                shuffledWords.forEach(word => {
                    const el = document.createElement('div');
                    el.className = 'match-item';
                    el.textContent = word.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + word.slice(1);
                    el.dataset.word = word;
                    el.setAttribute('role', 'button');
                    el.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
                    el.onclick = () => this.selectWord(el);
                    el.onkeypress = (e) => {
                        if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.selectWord(el);
                        }
                    };
                    wordCol.appendChild(el);
                });
                
                shuffledDefs.forEach(defObj => {
                    const el = document.createElement('div');
                    el.className = 'match-item';
                    el.textContent = defObj.def;
                    el.dataset.def = defObj.def;
                    el.dataset.word = defObj.word;
                    el.setAttribute('role', 'button');
                    el.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
                    el.onclick = () => this.selectDef(el);
                    el.onkeypress = (e) => {
                        if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.selectDef(el);
                        }
                    };
                    defCol.appendChild(el);
                });
                
                gameBox.appendChild(wordCol);
                gameBox.appendChild(defCol);
                this.container.appendChild(gameBox);
                
                const statsBox = document.createElement('div');
                statsBox.style.marginTop = '1em';
                statsBox.style.padding = '1em';
                statsBox.style.background = 'rgba(157, 0, 255, 0.1)';
                statsBox.style.borderRadius = '8px';
                statsBox.style.textAlign = 'center';
                statsBox.id = 'match-stats';
                statsBox.innerHTML = `<strong>Progress:</strong> ${this.matchedPairs} / ${this.words.length} pairs matched`;
                this.container.appendChild(statsBox);
            }

            updateStats() {
                const statsBox = document.getElementById('match-stats');
                if (statsBox) {
                    const accuracy = this.attempts > 0 ? Math.round((this.correctMatches / this.attempts) * 100) : 0;
                    statsBox.innerHTML = `<strong>Progress:</strong> ${this.matchedPairs} / ${this.words.length} pairs | <strong>Accuracy:</strong> ${accuracy}%`;
                }
            }

            selectWord(el) {
                if (el.classList.contains('matched')) return;
                document.querySelectorAll('.match-item[data-word]').forEach(item => {
                    if (item !== el) item.classList.remove('selected');
                });
                
                if (this.selectedWord === el) {
                    el.classList.remove('selected');
                    this.selectedWord = null;
                } else {
                    el.classList.add('selected');
                    this.selectedWord = el;
                }
                this.checkMatch();
            }

            selectDef(el) {
                if (el.classList.contains('matched')) return;
                document.querySelectorAll('.match-item[data-def]').forEach(item => {
                    if (item !== el) item.classList.remove('selected');
                });
                
                if (this.selectedDef === el) {
                    el.classList.remove('selected');
                    this.selectedDef = null;
                } else {
                    el.classList.add('selected');
                    this.selectedDef = el;
                }
                this.checkMatch();
            }

            checkMatch() {
                if (!this.selectedWord || !this.selectedDef) return;
                
                this.attempts++;
                const word = this.selectedWord.dataset.word;
                const defWord = this.selectedDef.dataset.word;
                
                if (word === defWord) {
                    this.correctMatches++;
                    this.setFeedback(`âœ… Perfect match! "${word.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + word.slice(1)}" is correct!`, 'success');
                    this.selectedWord.classList.add('matched');
                    this.selectedDef.classList.add('matched');
                    this.selectedWord.classList.remove('selected');
                    this.selectedDef.classList.remove('selected');
                    this.matchedPairs++;
                } else {
                    this.setFeedback(`âŒ Not a match. "${word.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + word.slice(1)}" doesn't match. Try again!`, 'error');
                    this.selectedWord.classList.remove('selected');
                    this.selectedDef.classList.remove('selected');
                }
                
                this.selectedWord = null;
                this.selectedDef = null;
                this.updateStats();
                
                if (this.matchedPairs === this.words.length) {
                    const accuracy = Math.round((this.correctMatches / this.attempts) * 100);
                    this.setFeedback(`ðŸŽ‰ All definitions matched! Final accuracy: ${accuracy}%`, 'success');
                    this.onSuccess();
                }
            }
        }

        // --- Initialize Everything ---
        window.onload = () => {
            const vocabList = Object.keys(vocabData);
            
            createVocabList();
            
            // E4 Version: New game word lists
            new VocabScrambleGame(

                    if (!lessonProgress.game1) {

            );
            
            const matchVocab = {};
            ['hobby', 'draw', 'music', 'sport', 'happy'].forEach(word => { // Game 2 uses these 5 words

            });
            new DefinitionMatchGame(

                () => {
                    const completeEl = document.getElementById('mission-complete-2');
                    completeEl.style.display = 'block';
                    completeEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
                    if (!lessonProgress.game2) {
                        lessonProgress.game2 = true;
                        updateLessonProgress();
                    }
                }
            );
            
            updateLessonProgress();
        };
    </script>

            -webkit-appearance: none;
            -moz-appearance: none;
            appearance: none;
            background-image: url('data:image/svg+xml;charset=US-ASCII,%3Csvg%20xmlns%3D%22http%3A%2F%2Fwww.w3.org%2F2000%2Fsvg%22%20width%3D%22292.4%22%20height%3D%22292.4%22%3E%3Cpath%20fill%3D%22%23FFD700%22%20d%3D%22M287%2069.4a17.6%2017.6%200%200%200-13-5.4H18.4c-5%200-9.3%201.8-12.9%205.4A17.6%2017.6%200%200%200%200%2082.2c0%205%201.8%209.3%205.4%2012.9l128%20128c3.6%203.6%207.8%205.4%2012.8%205.4s9.2-1.8%2012.8-5.4l128-128c3.6-3.6%205.4-7.8%205.4-12.8%200-5-1.8-9.2-5.4-12.8z%22%2F%3E%3C%2Fsvg%3E');
            background-repeat: no-repeat, repeat;
            background-position: right .7em top 50%, 0 0;
            background-size: .65em auto, 100%;
        }
        select {
            cursor: pointer;
        }
        select option {
            background: var(--bg-dark);
            color: var(--text-light);
            padding: 10px;
        }
        input[type="text"]:focus, select:focus {
            outline: none;
            border-color: var(--cyan);
            box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0, 255, 170, 0.4);
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0a0420 0%, #1a0a40 100%);
        }
        .feedback {
            margin-top: 1em;
            font-style: italic;
            font-weight: bold;
            min-height: 1.5em;
            padding: 0.75em;
            border-radius: 6px;
            transition: all 0.3s;
        }
        .feedback.success { 
            color: var(--success);
            background: rgba(0, 255, 170, 0.1);
            border-left: 4px solid var(--success);
        }
        .feedback.error { 
            color: var(--danger);
            background: rgba(255, 69, 0, 0.1);
            border-left: 4px solid var(--danger);
        }
        .feedback.warning {
            color: var(--warning);
            background: rgba(255, 165, 0, 0.1);
            border-left: 4px solid var(--warning);
        }
        .mission-complete {
            display: none;
            font-size: 2em;
            color: var(--success);
            text-align: center;
            padding: 2em;
            font-weight: bold;
            animation: pulse 1.5s infinite, confetti 0.5s;
            text-shadow: 0 0 15px var(--success);
        }
        .match-game-container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 1.5em;
        }
        .match-col {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 0.75em;
        }
        .match-col-header {
            font-weight: bold;
            font-size: 1.1em;
            color: var(--cyan);
            text-align: center;
            padding: 0.5em;
            background: rgba(157, 0, 255, 0.2);
            border-radius: 6px;
            margin-bottom: 0.5em;
        }
        .match-item {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple-dark) 0%, #1a0a40 100%);
            border: 2px solid var(--purple-bright);
            padding: 1em;
            border-radius: 8px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
            min-height: 50px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            text-align: center;
        }
        .match-item:hover:not(.matched) {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--purple-bright) 0%, #7700cc 100%);
            transform: translateX(5px);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(157, 0, 255, 0.5);
        }
        .match-item.selected {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gold) 0%, #ffed4e 100%);
            color: var(--text-dark);
            border-color: var(--gold);
            transform: scale(1.05);
            box-shadow: 0 6px 25px rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.6);
            font-weight: bold;
        }
        .match-item.matched {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1a1a 0%, #2a2a2a 100%);
            color: #666;
            border-color: #333;
            cursor: not-allowed;
            opacity: 0.5;
            transform: scale(0.95);
        }
        .gap-fill-container .gap-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            margin-bottom: 1em;
            gap: 10px;
        }
        .gap-fill-container .gap-item label {
            flex-basis: 60%;
            line-height: 1.6;
            color: var(--text-light);
        }
        .gap-fill-container .gap-item select {
            flex-basis: 40%;
        }
        .tip-box {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(157, 0, 255, 0.2) 0%, rgba(0, 255, 170, 0.2) 100%);
            padding: 1.5em;
            border-radius: 10px;
            border: 2px solid var(--cyan);
            margin-top: 1em;
            box-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(0, 255, 170, 0.3);
        }
        @keyframes pulse {
            0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0.8; }
            50% { transform: scale(1.05); opacity: 1; }
        }
        @keyframes shimmer {
            0% { background-position: -1000px 0; }
            100% { background-position: 1000px 0; }
        }
        @keyframes fadeIn {
            from { opacity: 0; }
            to { opacity: 1; }
        }
        @keyframes slideDown {
            from { 
                opacity: 0;
                transform: translateY(-10px);
            }
            to { 
                opacity: 1;
                transform: translateY(0);
            }
        }
        @keyframes confetti {
            0% { transform: scale(0.5) rotate(-45deg); }
            50% { transform: scale(1.2) rotate(45deg); }
            100% { transform: scale(1) rotate(0deg); }
        }
        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            main {
                padding: 1em;
            }
            .vocab-list {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
            .match-game-container {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
            header h1 {
                font-size: 1.5em;
            }
            .gap-fill-container .gap-item {
                flex-direction: column;
                align-items: flex-start;
            }
            .gap-fill-container .gap-item select {
                width: 100%;
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <header>
        <h1>B1/B2 Intermediate: What's Your Passion?</h1>
    </header>
    <main>
        <section>
            <h2>ðŸ“Š Lesson Progress</h2>

                <div class="progress-bar" id="lesson-progress-bar">0%</div>
