        // --- 1. Progress & Theme Logic ---

        function updateLessonProgress() {
            let completedTasks = 0;
            if (lessonProgress.reading) completedTasks++;
            if (lessonProgress.game1) completedTasks++;
            if (lessonProgress.game2) completedTasks++;
            if (lessonProgress.game3) completedTasks++;
            
            const percentage = Math.round((completedTasks / lessonProgress.totalTasks) * 100);
            const progressBar = document.getElementById('lesson-progress-bar');
            
            progressBar.style.width = percentage + '%';
            progressBar.textContent = percentage + '%';
            
            document.getElementById('stat-reading').classList.toggle('completed', lessonProgress.reading);
            document.getElementById('stat-reading').querySelector('.stat-value').textContent = lessonProgress.reading ? 'âœ“' : 'â—‹';
            
            document.getElementById('stat-game1').classList.toggle('completed', lessonProgress.game1);
            document.getElementById('stat-game1').querySelector('.stat-value').textContent = lessonProgress.game1 ? 'âœ“' : 'â—‹';
            
            document.getElementById('stat-game2').classList.toggle('completed', lessonProgress.game2);
            document.getElementById('stat-game2').querySelector('.stat-value').textContent = lessonProgress.game2 ? 'âœ“' : 'â—‹';

            document.getElementById('stat-game3').classList.toggle('completed', lessonProgress.game3);
            document.getElementById('stat-game3').querySelector('.stat-value').textContent = lessonProgress.game3 ? 'âœ“' : 'â—‹';
            
            if (percentage === 100) {
                document.getElementById('global-mission-complete').style.display = 'block';
                progressBar.style.background = 'linear-gradient(90deg, var(--gold) 0%, var(--cyan) 100%)';
                document.getElementById('global-mission-complete').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
            }
            
            // Save progress to localStorage (Suggestion #45)
            localStorage.setItem('lessonProgress', JSON.stringify(lessonProgress));
        }

        function loadProgress() {
            const savedProgress = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('lessonProgress'));
            if (savedProgress) {
                Object.assign(lessonProgress, savedProgress);
            }
            updateLessonProgress();
        }

        // --- 2. Vocab List ---

        function createVocabList() {
            const container = document.getElementById('vocab-list-container');
            container.innerHTML = ''; 
            for (const [key, data] of Object.entries(vocabData)) {
                const item = document.createElement('div');
                item.className = 'vocab-item';
                item.setAttribute('role', 'button');
                item.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');

                const term = data.term || key; // Use 'term' field if it exists (for idioms)
                const termText = term.split(' ').map(w => w.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + w.slice(1)).join(' ');
                
                const header = document.createElement('div');
                header.className = 'vocab-header';
                header.textContent = termText;

                // Suggestion #19: Audio playback
                const listen = document.createElement('span');
                listen.className = 'vocab-listen';
                listen.textContent = ' ðŸŽ¤ (listen)';
                listen.setAttribute('role', 'button');
                listen.setAttribute('aria-label', `Listen to ${termText}`);
                listen.onclick = (e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    // Mock audio playback
                    alert(`Playing audio for: ${termText}`);
                };
                header.appendChild(listen);
                item.appendChild(header);

                const details = document.createElement('div');
                details.className = 'vocab-details';
                
                const definition = document.createElement('div');
                definition.className = 'definition';
                definition.textContent = 'ðŸ“– ' + data.def;
                definition.setAttribute('role', 'button');
                definition.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
                
                const translation = document.createElement('div');
                translation.className = 'translation';
                translation.textContent = 'ðŸ‡»ðŸ‡³ ' + data.trans;
                
                definition.onclick = (e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    const isVisible = translation.style.display === 'block';
                    translation.style.display = isVisible ? 'none' : 'block';
                };
                
                definition.onkeypress = (e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        definition.onclick(e);
                    }
                };
                
                details.appendChild(definition);
                details.appendChild(translation);
                item.appendChild(details);
                
                const toggleVocab = () => {
                    document.querySelectorAll('.vocab-item.active').forEach(activeItem => {
                        if(activeItem !== item) {
                            activeItem.classList.remove('active');
                            activeItem.querySelector('.translation').style.display = 'none';
                        }
                    });
                    item.classList.toggle('active');
                    if (!item.classList.contains('active')) {
                        translation.style.display = 'none';
                    }
                };
                
                item.onclick = toggleVocab;
                item.onkeypress = (e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        toggleVocab();
                    }
                };
                
                container.appendChild(item);
            }
        }

        // --- 3. Reading Task: Gap-Fill ---

        const gapFillData = [
            { id: 'gap1', text: 'She had a strong ___ to become a doctor.', answer: 'ambition' },
            { id: 'gap2', text: 'You must have ___ and keep practicing, even when it is hard.', answer: 'perseverance' },
            { id: 'gap3', text: 'His ___ for science started when he was a child.', answer: 'passion' },
            { id: 'gap4', text: 'What is your ___ for working so hard?', answer: 'motivation' },
            { id: 'gap5', text: 'The team showed great ___ to the project.', answer: 'commitment' },
            { id: 'gap6', text: 'It takes ___ to start a new business from nothing.', answer: 'drive' },
            { id: 'gap7', text: 'He showed great ___ after losing his job; he found a new one quickly.', answer: 'resilience' },
            { id: 'gap8', text: 'Her ___ led her to explore the old library.', answer: 'curiosity' },
            { id: 'gap9', text: 'They showed a lot of ___ for the new plan.', answer: 'enthusiasm' },
            { id: 'gap10', text: 'Becoming a musician requires years of ___.', answer: 'dedication' }
        ];
        
        const vocabList = ['passion', 'motivation', 'drive', 'dedication', 'perseverance', 'ambition', 'curiosity', 'enthusiasm', 'commitment', 'resilience'];

        function createGapFill() {
            const container = document.getElementById('gap-fill-container');
            container.innerHTML = '';
            
            gapFillData.forEach(item => {
                const itemDiv = document.createElement('div');
                itemDiv.className = 'gap-item';
                
                const label = document.createElement('label');
                label.htmlFor = item.id;
                label.textContent = item.text.replace('___', ' _____ ');
                
                const select = document.createElement('select');
                select.id = item.id;
                select.name = item.id;
                select.dataset.answer = item.answer;
                
                const defaultOption = document.createElement('option');
                defaultOption.value = "";
                defaultOption.textContent = "--- Select a word ---";
                select.appendChild(defaultOption);
                
                vocabList.forEach(word => {
                    const option = document.createElement('option');
                    option.value = word;
                    option.textContent = word.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + word.slice(1);
                    select.appendChild(option);
                });
                
                itemDiv.appendChild(label);
                itemDiv.appendChild(select);
                container.appendChild(itemDiv);
            });
        }
        
        document.getElementById('writing-prompt-submit').addEventListener('click', () => {
            const feedback = document.getElementById('writing-feedback');
            let correctCount = 0;
            const total = gapFillData.length;
            
            gapFillData.forEach(item => {
                const select = document.getElementById(item.id);
                if (select.value === item.answer) {
                    correctCount++;
                    select.style.borderColor = 'var(--success)';
                } else {
                    select.style.borderColor = 'var(--danger)';
                }
            });
            
            if (correctCount === total) {
                feedback.textContent = `âœ… Perfect! You got ${correctCount}/${total} correct. Your understanding of this vocabulary is excellent!`;
                feedback.className = "feedback success";
                if (!lessonProgress.reading) {
                    lessonProgress.reading = true;
                    updateLessonProgress();
                }
            } else if (correctCount >= total * 0.7) {
                feedback.textContent = `ðŸ“ Good job! You got ${correctCount}/${total} correct. Review the words you missed.`;
                feedback.className = "feedback warning";
                if (!lessonProgress.reading) {
                    lessonProgress.reading = true;
                    updateLessonProgress();
                }
            } else {
                feedback.textContent = `âŒ Not quite. You got ${correctCount}/${total}. Please review the vocabulary and try again.`;
                feedback.className = "feedback error";
            }
            feedback.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
        });

        // --- Game 1: Flashcard Review (Suggestion #24) ---
        class FlashcardGame {
            constructor(containerId, words, feedbackId, onSuccessCallback) {
                this.container = document.getElementById(containerId);
                this.feedbackEl = document.getElementById(feedbackId);
                this.onSuccess = onSuccessCallback;
                this.words = this.shuffleArray([...words]);
                this.currentWordIndex = 0;

                this.card = document.getElementById('flashcard');
                this.cardFront = document.getElementById('flashcard-front');
                this.cardBack = document.getElementById('flashcard-back');
                this.btnYes = document.getElementById('flashcard-btn-yes');
                this.btnNo = document.getElementById('flashcard-btn-no');
                this.progressText = document.getElementById('flashcard-progress');
                
                this.card.addEventListener('click', () => this.flipCard());
                this.card.addEventListener('keypress', (e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') this.flipCard();
                });
                this.btnYes.addEventListener('click', () => this.nextCard(true));
                this.btnNo.addEventListener('click', () => this.nextCard(false));
                
                this.showCard();
            }

            shuffleArray(array) {
                for (let i = array.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
                    const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
                    [array[i], array[j]] = [array[j], array[i]];
                }
                return array;
            }

            flipCard() {
                this.card.classList.toggle('is-flipped');
            }

            showCard() {
                if (this.currentWordIndex >= this.words.length) {
                    this.container.innerHTML = '';
                    this.setFeedback('ðŸŽ‰ Great review session! You have finished these flashcards.', 'success');
                    this.onSuccess();
                    return;
                }
                
                const key = this.words[this.currentWordIndex];
                const data = vocabData[key];
                const term = data.term || key;
                
                this.card.classList.remove('is-flipped');
                
                this.cardFront.textContent = term.split(' ').map(w => w.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + w.slice(1)).join(' ');
                this.cardBack.querySelector('.definition').textContent = 'ðŸ“– ' + data.def;
                this.cardBack.querySelector('.translation').textContent = 'ðŸ‡»ðŸ‡³ ' + data.trans;
                this.progressText.textContent = `${this.currentWordIndex + 1} / ${this.words.length}`;
            }

            nextCard(known) {
                if (!this.card.classList.contains('is-flipped')) {
                    this.setFeedback('Flip the card to see the definition first!', 'warning');
                    return;
                }
                
                this.setFeedback('');
                this.currentWordIndex++;
                
                if (known) {
                    // You could add logic here to track 'known' words
                } else {
                    // Add logic to re-add this word to the deck later
                }
                
                setTimeout(() => this.showCard(), 300); // Wait for flip animation
            }
            
            setFeedback(message, className = '') {
                if (this.feedbackEl) {
                    this.feedbackEl.textContent = message;
                    this.feedbackEl.className = className ? 'feedback ' + className : 'feedback';
                }
            }
        }
        
        // --- Game 2 & 3: Definition Match (Reusable Class) ---
        class DefinitionMatchGame {
            constructor(containerId, items, feedbackId, onSuccessCallback) {
                this.container = document.getElementById(containerId);
                this.feedbackEl = document.getElementById(feedbackId);
                this.items = items; // This now expects an object like {'key': {def: '...', trans: '...'}}
                this.onSuccess = onSuccessCallback;
                this.itemKeys = Object.keys(items);
                this.definitions = this.itemKeys.map(key => ({ key, def: items[key].def }));
                this.selectedItem = null;
                this.selectedDef = null;
                this.matchedPairs = 0;
                this.attempts = 0;
                this.correctMatches = 0;
                this.init();
            }

            shuffleArray(array) {
                const newArray = [...array];
                for (let i = newArray.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
                    const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
                    [newArray[i], newArray[j]] = [newArray[j], newArray[i]];
                }
                return newArray;
            }

            setFeedback(message, className = '') {
                if (this.feedbackEl) {
                    this.feedbackEl.textContent = message;
                    this.feedbackEl.className = className ? 'feedback ' + className : 'feedback';
                }
            }

            init() {
                this.container.innerHTML = '';
                this.setFeedback('ðŸŽ¯ Match each item to its definition. Select one item and one definition to make a pair.');
                
                const gameBox = document.createElement('div');
                gameBox.className = 'match-game-container';
                
                const itemCol = document.createElement('div');
                itemCol.className = 'match-col';
                const itemHeader = document.createElement('div');
                itemHeader.className = 'match-col-header';
                itemHeader.textContent = 'ðŸ“ ITEMS';
                itemCol.appendChild(itemHeader);
                
                const defCol = document.createElement('div');
                defCol.className = 'match-col';
                const defHeader = document.createElement('div');
                defHeader.className = 'match-col-header';
                defHeader.textContent = 'ðŸ“– DEFINITIONS';
                defCol.appendChild(defHeader);
                
                const shuffledKeys = this.shuffleArray([...this.itemKeys]);
                const shuffledDefs = this.shuffleArray([...this.definitions]);
                
                shuffledKeys.forEach(key => {
                    const el = document.createElement('div');
                    el.className = 'match-item';
                    const term = this.items[key].term || key; // Use 'term' field if available
                    el.textContent = term.split(' ').map(w => w.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + w.slice(1)).join(' ');
                    el.dataset.key = key;
                    el.setAttribute('role', 'button');
                    el.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
                    el.onclick = () => this.selectItem(el);
                    el.onkeypress = (e) => {
                        if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); this.selectItem(el); }
                    };
                    itemCol.appendChild(el);
                });
                
                shuffledDefs.forEach(defObj => {
                    const el = document.createElement('div');
                    el.className = 'match-item';
                    el.textContent = defObj.def;
                    el.dataset.def = defObj.def;
                    el.dataset.key = defObj.key; // The key (e.g., 'passion') is the link
                    el.setAttribute('role', 'button');
                    el.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
                    el.onclick = () => this.selectDef(el);
                    el.onkeypress = (e) => {
                        if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); this.selectDef(el); }
                    };
                    defCol.appendChild(el);
                });
                
                gameBox.appendChild(itemCol);
                gameBox.appendChild(defCol);
                this.container.appendChild(gameBox);
                
                const statsBox = document.createElement('div');
                statsBox.style.marginTop = '1em';
                statsBox.style.padding = '1em';
                statsBox.style.background = 'rgba(56, 182, 255, 0.1)';
                statsBox.style.borderRadius = '8px';
                statsBox.style.textAlign = 'center';
                statsBox.id = `match-stats-${this.container.id}`;
                statsBox.innerHTML = `<strong>Progress:</strong> ${this.matchedPairs} / ${this.itemKeys.length} pairs matched`;
                this.container.appendChild(statsBox);
            }

            updateStats() {
                const statsBox = document.getElementById(`match-stats-${this.container.id}`);
                if (statsBox) {
                    const accuracy = this.attempts > 0 ? Math.round((this.correctMatches / this.attempts) * 100) : 0;
                    statsBox.innerHTML = `<strong>Progress:</strong> ${this.matchedPairs} / ${this.itemKeys.length} pairs | <strong>Accuracy:</strong> ${accuracy}%`;
                }
            }

            selectItem(el) {
                if (el.classList.contains('matched')) return;
                this.container.querySelectorAll('.match-item[data-key]').forEach(item => {
                    if (item !== el) item.classList.remove('selected');
                });
                
                if (this.selectedItem === el) {
                    el.classList.remove('selected');
                    this.selectedItem = null;
                } else {
                    el.classList.add('selected');
                    this.selectedItem = el;
                }
                this.checkMatch();
            }

            selectDef(el) {
                if (el.classList.contains('matched')) return;
                this.container.querySelectorAll('.match-item[data-def]').forEach(item => {
                    if (item !== el) item.classList.remove('selected');
                });
                
                if (this.selectedDef === el) {
                    el.classList.remove('selected');
                    this.selectedDef = null;
                } else {
                    el.classList.add('selected');
                    this.selectedDef = el;
                }
                this.checkMatch();
            }

            checkMatch() {
                if (!this.selectedItem || !this.selectedDef) return;
                
                this.attempts++;
                const itemKey = this.selectedItem.dataset.key;
                const defKey = this.selectedDef.dataset.key;
                
                if (itemKey === defKey) {
                    this.correctMatches++;
                    this.setFeedback(`âœ… Perfect match!`, 'success');
                    this.selectedItem.classList.add('matched');
                    this.selectedDef.classList.add('matched');
                    this.selectedItem.classList.remove('selected');
                    this.selectedDef.classList.remove('selected');
                    this.matchedPairs++;
                } else {
                    this.setFeedback(`âŒ Not a match. Try again!`, 'error');
                    this.selectedItem.classList.remove('selected');
                    this.selectedDef.classList.remove('selected');
                }
                
                this.selectedItem = null;
                this.selectedDef = null;
                this.updateStats();
                
                if (this.matchedPairs === this.itemKeys.length) {
                    const accuracy = Math.round((this.correctMatches / this.attempts) * 100);
                    this.setFeedback(`ðŸŽ‰ All definitions matched! Final accuracy: ${accuracy}%`, 'success');
                    this.onSuccess();
                }
            }
        }
        
        // --- 4. Tool & Tip Logic ---

            const tipEl = document.getElementById('tip');

You build it with <strong>curiosity</strong> (asking questions), <strong>dedication</strong> (practicing), and <strong>resilience</strong> (learning from failure). If you want to find your passion, don't wait for a special feelingâ€”start doing something you find interesting.</div>`;
            tipButton.disabled = true;
            tipButton.textContent = 'Wisdom Revealed âœ“';
            tipEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
        }

        function initStudentTools() {
            // Notes (Suggestion #21)
            const notesEl = document.getElementById('student-notes');
            notesEl.value = localStorage.getItem('studentNotes') || '';
            notesEl.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
                localStorage.setItem('studentNotes', e.target.value);
            });

            // Timer (Suggestion #29)
            const timerEl = document.getElementById('lesson-timer');
            let totalSeconds = parseInt(localStorage.getItem('lessonTime') || 0);
            
            setInterval(() => {
                totalSeconds++;
                const minutes = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 60).toString().padStart(2, '0');
                const seconds = (totalSeconds % 60).toString().padStart(2, '0');
                timerEl.textContent = `${minutes}:${seconds}`;
                localStorage.setItem('lessonTime', totalSeconds);
            }, 1000);
        }

        // --- 5. Teacher Controls (Suggestion #31-33) ---

        function initTeacherControls() {
            // Reset Progress
            document.getElementById('btn-reset-progress').addEventListener('click', () => {
                if (confirm('Are you sure you want to reset all lesson progress? This cannot be undone.')) {
                    localStorage.removeItem('lessonProgress');
                    localStorage.removeItem('studentNotes');
                    localStorage.removeItem('lessonTime');
                    window.location.reload();
                }
            });

            // Export Data (Suggestion #32, #50)
            document.getElementById('btn-export-data').addEventListener('click', () => {
                const data = {
                    progress: JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('lessonProgress') || '{}'),
                    notes: localStorage.getItem('studentNotes') || '',
                    timeSeconds: parseInt(localStorage.getItem('lessonTime') || 0)
                };
                const dataStr = "data:text/json;charset=utf-8," + encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(data, null, 2));
                const dlElement = document.createElement('a');
                dlElement.setAttribute("href", dataStr);
                dlElement.setAttribute("download", "lesson_progress_export.json");
                dlElement.click();
            });
        }

        // --- 6. Theme Toggle (Suggestion #8) ---
        
        function initThemeToggle() {
            const toggleBtn = document.getElementById('theme-toggle-btn');
            const currentTheme = localStorage.getItem('theme');
            
            if (currentTheme === 'light') {
                document.body.classList.add('theme-light');
                toggleBtn.textContent = 'â˜€ï¸';
            }
            
            toggleBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                document.body.classList.toggle('theme-light');
                let theme = 'dark';
                if (document.body.classList.contains('theme-light')) {
                    theme = 'light';
                    toggleBtn.textContent = 'â˜€ï¸';
                } else {
                    toggleBtn.textContent = 'ðŸŒ™';
                }
                localStorage.setItem('theme', theme);
            });
        }

        // --- Initialize Everything on DOM Load (Suggestion #43) ---
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            
            createVocabList();
            createGapFill();
            
            // --- Game 1 Setup (Flashcards) ---
            const flashcardWords = ['passion', 'drive', 'ambition', 'curiosity', 'commitment'];
            new FlashcardGame(
                'gameContainer1',
                flashcardWords,
                'game-feedback-1',
                () => {
                    const completeEl = document.getElementById('mission-complete-1');
                    completeEl.style.display = 'block';
                    completeEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
                    if (!lessonProgress.game1) {
                        lessonProgress.game1 = true;
                        updateLessonProgress();
                    }
                }
            );
            
            // --- Game 2 Setup (Vocab Match) ---
            const matchVocab = {};
            ['motivation', 'dedication', 'perseverance', 'enthusiasm', 'resilience'].forEach(word => {
                matchVocab[word] = vocabData[word];
            });
            new DefinitionMatchGame(
                'gameContainer2',
                matchVocab,
                'game-feedback-2',
                () => {
                    const completeEl = document.getElementById('mission-complete-2');
                    completeEl.style.display = 'block';
                    completeEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
                    if (!lessonProgress.game2) {
                        lessonProgress.game2 = true;
                        updateLessonProgress();
                    }
                }
            );

            // --- Game 3 Setup (Idiom Match) ---
            const idiomVocab = {};
            ['idiom_calling', 'idiom_heart', 'idiom_mile', 'idiom_oil', 'idiom_sweat'].forEach(key => {
                idiomVocab[key] = vocabData[key];
            });
            new DefinitionMatchGame(
                'gameContainer3',
                idiomVocab,
                'game-feedback-3',
                () => {
                    const completeEl = document.getElementById('mission-complete-3');
                    completeEl.style.display = 'block';
                    completeEl.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
                    if (!lessonProgress.game3) {
                        lessonProgress.game3 = true;
                        updateLessonProgress();
                    }
                }
            );
            
            // Init Tools
            initStudentTools();
            initTeacherControls();
            initThemeToggle();

            // Load initial progress
            loadProgress();
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Poppins:wght@400;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    <style>
        :root {
            /* NET Official Gold/Purple Theme (Certified V5.0 Aesthetics) */
            --color-primary-gold: #D4AF37;
            --color-primary-purple: #6B4C9A;
            --color-purple-light: #9B7CB8;
            --color-bg-dark: #1A1A2E;
            --color-bg-card: #2D2D44;
            --color-text-light: #FFFFFF;
            --color-gold-light: #F4E4A6;
            --color-text-muted: #C8C8D8;
        }
        html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
        body { 
            font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
            background: var(--color-bg-dark);
            color: var(--color-text-light);
            min-height: 100vh;
            background-image: 
                radial-gradient(circle at 20% 50%, rgba(107, 76, 154, 0.15) 0%, transparent 50%),
                radial-gradient(circle at 80% 80%, rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.1) 0%, transparent 50%);
        }
        .net-header h1 {
            font-size: 2.5rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-gold-light) 0%, var(--color-primary-gold) 50%);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
        }
        .container { max-width: 1400px; }
        
        /* Interactive Card Styling (Singularity Program Style) */
        .lesson-card {
            background: var(--color-bg-card);
            border: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.2);
            border-radius: 12px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.8, 0.25, 1);
            overflow: hidden;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
        }
        .lesson-card:not(.expanded):hover {
            transform: translateY(-5px) scale(1.03);
            box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.3);
            border-color: var(--color-primary-gold);
        }
        .lesson-card.expanded {
            position: fixed; top: 5vh; left: 5vw; width: 90vw; height: 90vh; cursor: default; z-index: 50; overflow-y: auto; background: var(--color-bg-dark);
        }
        
        .lesson-card .overview-content { transition: opacity 0.3s ease; }
        .lesson-card.expanded .overview-content { opacity: 0; height: 0; }
        .lesson-card .full-lesson-content { visibility: hidden; opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px); transition: opacity 0.4s ease 0.3s, transform 0.4s ease 0.3s, visibility 0s 0.7s; }
        .lesson-card.expanded .full-lesson-content { visibility: visible; opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); transition-delay: 0.3s; }
        
        .lesson-nav-button {
            padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: 8px; transition: all 0.3s ease;
            color: var(--color-text-muted); background-color: transparent;
            border: 1px solid transparent;
        }
        .lesson-nav-button.active {
            background: var(--color-primary-purple); color: var(--color-gold-light);
            box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(107, 76, 154, 0.5);
            border-color: var(--color-gold-light);
        }
        
        /* General Styles */
        h2 { font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 800; color: var(--color-gold-light); }
        h3 { font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--color-primary-gold); }
        .tab-content-container { max-height: 65vh; overflow-y: auto; padding-right: 15px; }
        .backdrop { z-index: 40; }
        
        /* Modal Content Scrollbar */
        .tab-content-container::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 8px; }
        .tab-content-container::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: var(--color-bg-dark); }
        .tab-content-container::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--color-primary-purple); border-radius: 10px; }
    </style>
</head>
<body class="p-4 md:p-8">

    <div class="container mx-auto">
        <header class="net-header text-center mb-10">
            <h1>THE GEOPOLITICS PROGRAM</h1>
            <p class="text-xl mt-1 text-purple-light">V5.0 Certified Content Standard (20 Lessons)</p>
        </header>

        <section id="explorer" class="mb-12">
            <div class="text-center max-w-3xl mx-auto mb-8">
                <h2 class="text-2xl font-bold text-primary-gold mb-4">Interactive Curriculum Explorer</h2>
                <p class="text-md text-text-muted">Explore the curriculum by selecting a specific lesson, or filter by a core pillar to see that topic's progression through the entire course.</p>
            </div>
            <div id="lesson-grid" class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 xl:grid-cols-5 gap-6">
                </div>
        </section>
    </div>
    
    <div id="backdrop" class="fixed inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-70 z-40 transition-opacity duration-500 opacity-0 pointer-events-none"></div>

    <script type="application/json" id="geopolitics-data-json">
    [
        {
            "lesson": 1, "pillar": "Foundations", "title": "The State & Sovereignty",
            "introduction": "Before analyzing the global chess game, we must understand the board and the pieces. This lesson explores the fundamental concepts of the State and its right to rule, Sovereignty, which shape borders, authority, and international relations.",
            "tabs": [
                {"name": "Key Concepts", "icon": "ðŸŽ¯", "content": [{"term": "State", "def": "A politically organized territory with a government, defined borders, and a permanent population."}, {"term": "Sovereignty", "def": "The supreme authority within a territory, meaning a state is independent and not controlled by outside forces."}, {"term": "Nation-State", "def": "An ideal form where a state's political borders coincide with the cultural boundaries of a single ethnic or cultural group."}]},
                {"name": "Deeper Analysis", "icon": "ðŸ§ ", "content": "The modern state system, often called the Westphalian system, originated in 17th century Europe. It assumes that each state has exclusive sovereignty over its territory. However, this is constantly challenged by globalization, international law, and powerful non-state actors. The tension between the theoretical ideal of sovereignty and the practical reality of an interconnected world is a central theme in all of geopolitics."},
                {"name": "Hypothetical Scenario", "icon": "âš™ï¸", "content": "A powerful tech company creates a self-sustaining floating city in international waters with its own laws and security. Is it a state? Does it have sovereignty? What happens when it projects its power onto existing nations? This scenario forces us to question if our centuries-old definitions are adequate for the future."},
                {"name": "Critical Thinking", "icon": "ðŸ¤”", "content": ["Is the concept of a 'Nation-State' becoming obsolete in a globalized world?", "Can sovereignty exist when multinational corporations are more powerful than some states?", "How does the internet challenge traditional notions of borders and state control?"]}
            ],
            "takeaway": "The difference between a 'State' (political entity) and a 'Nation' (cultural group) is critical to understanding global conflicts."
        }
    ]
    </script>

    <script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
        let LESSON_DATA = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('geopolitics-data-json').textContent);
        
        // --- DATA FILLER (Creates 20 lessons for structural fidelity) ---
        const originalLength = LESSON_DATA.length;
        if (originalLength < 20) {
            for (let i = originalLength + 1; i <= 20; i++) {
                const pillarList = ["Theories & Thinkers", "Resources & Conflict", "Modern Arenas", "Future & Synthesis"];
                LESSON_DATA.push({
                    "lesson": i, 
                    "pillar": pillarList[(i - 1) % pillarList.length], 
                    "title": `Lesson ${i}: Structural Integrity Check`,
                    "introduction": `This lesson is a placeholder confirming the structural fidelity of the 20-lesson program.`,
                    "tabs": [
                        { "name": "Key Concepts", "icon": "ðŸŽ¯", "content": [{"term": `Concept for L${i}`, "def": "Detailed definition."}] },
                        { "name": "Critical Thinking", "icon": "ðŸ¤”", "content": [`Core assumption of Lesson ${i}?`] }
                    ],
                    "takeaway": `Key takeaway for Lesson ${i}.`
                });
            }
        }
        
        const lessonGrid = document.getElementById('lesson-grid');
        const backdrop = document.getElementById('backdrop');

        function renderOverviewCards() {
            lessonGrid.innerHTML = '';
            LESSON_DATA.forEach(lesson => {
                const card = document.createElement('div');
                card.className = 'lesson-card';
                card.id = `lesson-card-${lesson.lesson}`;
                card.dataset.lessonId = lesson.lesson;

                // Overview Content (always present)
                const overviewContent = document.createElement('div');
                overviewContent.className = 'overview-content p-4 text-center';
                overviewContent.innerHTML = `
                    <p class="font-bold text-lg text-primary-gold">Lesson ${lesson.lesson}</p>
                    <p class="text-sm text-text-muted">${lesson.title}</p>
                    <p class="text-xs mt-1 text-purple-light">${lesson.pillar}</p>
                `;
                
                // Full Lesson Content (initially hidden)
                const fullLessonContent = document.createElement('div');
                fullLessonContent.className = 'full-lesson-content';

                card.appendChild(overviewContent);
                card.appendChild(fullLessonContent);
                lessonGrid.appendChild(card);
            });
        }

        function expandLesson(lessonId) {
            const allCards = document.querySelectorAll('.lesson-card');
            const targetCard = document.getElementById(`lesson-card-${lessonId}`);
            
            if (!targetCard || targetCard.classList.contains('expanded')) return; 

            const lesson = LESSON_DATA.find(l => l.lesson == lessonId);
            if (!lesson) return;
            
            // Inject full lesson HTML
            let tabsHtml = lesson.tabs.map((tab, index) => `<button class="lesson-nav-button ${index === 0 ? 'active' : ''}" data-target="tab-${lessonId}-${index}">${tab.icon} ${tab.name}</button>`).join('');
            let tabContentHtml = lesson.tabs.map((tab, index) => {
                let contentHtml = '';
                if (Array.isArray(tab.content) && tab.content.length > 0 && tab.content[0].term) {
                    // For Key Concepts (objects with term/def)
                    contentHtml = tab.content.map(c => `<li class="mb-3"><strong class="text-gold-light">${c.term}:</strong> <span class="text-text-muted">${c.def}</span></li>`).join('');
                    contentHtml = `<ul class="list-none pl-0 space-y-2">${contentHtml}</ul>`;
                } else if (Array.isArray(tab.content)) {
                    // For Critical Thinking and Questions
                    contentHtml = tab.content.map(q => `<li class="mb-2">${q}</li>`).join('');
                    contentHtml = `<ul class="list-disc pl-5 space-y-2 text-text-muted">${contentHtml}</ul>`;
                } else {
                    // For Deeper Analysis and Narrative blocks (plain string)
                    contentHtml = `<p class="text-text-muted leading-relaxed">${tab.content}</p>`;
                }
                
                return `<div id="tab-${lessonId}-${index}" class="lesson-tab-content ${index === 0 ? '' : 'hidden'} mt-6">${contentHtml}</div>`;
            }).join('');

            targetCard.querySelector('.full-lesson-content').innerHTML = `
                <div class="p-4 md:p-8">
                    <button id="close-lesson-btn" class="absolute top-4 right-4 text-3xl text-gold-light hover:text-primary-gold z-20 transition-colors">&times;</button>

                    <header class="text-center pb-8 sticky top-0 z-10 bg-bg-dark pt-4">
                        <h1 class="text-3xl font-bold text-primary-gold">Lesson ${lesson.lesson}: ${lesson.title}</h1>
                        <p class="text-lg mt-2 text-text-muted">${lesson.introduction}</p>
                    </header>
                    
                    <nav class="sticky top-20 z-10 p-2 flex flex-wrap justify-center gap-2 mb-6 bg-bg-dark rounded-lg border border-primary-purple">
                        ${tabsHtml}
                    </nav>

                    <div class="lesson-tab-container">
                        <div class="tab-content-container">${tabContentHtml}</div>
                    </div>
                    
                    <div class="mt-8 pt-4 border-t border-primary-purple">
                        <p class="font-bold text-lg text-primary-gold">ðŸ’¡ Key Takeaway:</p>
                        <p class="text-text-muted italic">${lesson.takeaway}</p>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `;
            
            // Animate
            backdrop.classList.remove('opacity-0');
            allCards.forEach(card => {
                if (card.id !== targetCard.id) {
                    card.classList.add('minimized');
                }
            });
            targetCard.classList.add('expanded');

            // Add new JS listeners to the dynamically injected content (Resolves runtime error)
            targetCard.querySelector('#close-lesson-btn').addEventListener('click', collapseAllLessons);

            targetCard.querySelectorAll('.lesson-nav-button').forEach(button => {
                button.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                    e.stopPropagation();
                    const targetId = e.currentTarget.dataset.target;
                    targetCard.querySelectorAll('.lesson-tab-content').forEach(el => el.classList.add('hidden'));
                    targetCard.querySelectorAll('.lesson-nav-button').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('active'));
                    document.getElementById(targetId).classList.remove('hidden');
                    e.currentTarget.classList.add('active');
                });
            });
        }
        
        function collapseAllLessons() {
            const expandedCard = document.querySelector('.lesson-card.expanded');
            if (!expandedCard) return;
            
            // Animate out
            backdrop.classList.add('opacity-0');
            
            expandedCard.classList.remove('expanded');
            document.querySelectorAll('.lesson-card.minimized').forEach(card => {
                card.classList.remove('minimized');
            });

            // Delay clearing content until after transition for smoother effect
            setTimeout(() => {
                expandedCard.querySelector('.full-lesson-content').innerHTML = '';
            }, 500); 
        }

        window.collapseAllLessons = collapseAllLessons;
        
        // --- INITIALIZATION ---
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            renderOverviewCards();
            lessonGrid.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                const card = e.target.closest('.lesson-card');
                if (card && !card.classList.contains('expanded')) {
                    expandLesson(card.dataset.lessonId);
                }
            });
            backdrop.addEventListener('click', collapseAllLessons);
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

            category: qa.category,
            question: qa.question,
            result: result,
            risk: risk,
            devil_advocate: devil_advocate,
            timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
            metadata: {
                priority: risk === 'High' ? 'Critical' : 'Normal',
                auto_fix_possible: result === 'WARN' || result === 'QUESTION',
            }
        };
    };

    // --- 4. SIMULATION CORE (The Heart of the Protocol) ---

    function simulateSeed(seedIndex, questions) {
        let stats = { total: 0, pass: 0, warn: 0, fail: 0 };
        let idx = 0;
        const seedId = `SEED_${seedIndex + 1}`;
        // Initialize seed state for tracking
        seedStates[seedId] = {
            id: seedId,
            color: ['#9D00FF', '#00E0FF', '#FFD700', '#00FF88', '#FF4444'][seedIndex],
            stats: stats,
            status: 'RUNNING',
            audits: []
        };
        // Mocked UI Update/Logging functions for Auditable JS
        const mockLog = (msg, type) => console.log(`[LOG::${seedId}::${type}] ${msg}`);
        const mockUpdateUI = (s, p) => { /* Client Poller handles DOM update */ };

        function nextQuestion() {
            // Hardened Pause Check (Snippet 47)
            if (isPaused) {
                seedStates[seedId].status = 'PAUSED';
                setTimeout(nextQuestion, 100);
                return;
            }
            seedStates[seedId].status = 'RUNNING';

            if (idx >= questions.length) {
                seedStates[seedId].status = 'COMPLETE';
                mockLog('COMPLETE', 'SUCCESS');
                // Mock Confetti Trigger (Snippet 50)
                if (stats.fail === 0 && stats.total > 0) mockLog('Confetti Triggered', 'FX');
                return;
            }
            
            const q = questions[idx];
            idx++;
            
            // Random result generation (Simulation Logic)
            const random = Math.random();
            let result;
            if (random < 0.05) result = 'FAIL';
            else if (random < 0.15) result = 'WARN';
            else result = 'PASS'; // Simplified distribution

            // Update stats
            stats.total++;
            if (result === 'PASS') stats.pass++;
            else if (result === 'FAIL') stats.fail++;
            else stats.warn++;

            // Global synchronization (Snippet 44)
            globalStats.total++;
            globalStats.pass += (result === 'PASS' ? 1 : 0);
            globalStats.warn += (result === 'WARN' ? 1 : 0);
            globalStats.fail += (result === 'FAIL' ? 1 : 0);

            // Store audit data (V6 Requirement)
            const auditPoint = generateAuditPoint(q, result, seedId);
            condensedAuditData.push(auditPoint);
            seedStates[seedId].audits.push({ id: q.id, result: result, timestamp: auditPoint.timestamp });

            mockLog(`QA-${q.id} ${q.checkpoint} >> ${result}`, result);
            mockUpdateUI(stats, (idx / questions.length) * 100);
            // Speed Control (Snippet 48)
            setTimeout(nextQuestion, baseDelay + Math.random() * 30);
        }
        
        nextQuestion();
    }

    // --- 5. INITIALIZATION & EXECUTION ---

    // Define Master Control Methods (Snippet 45, 47, 49)
    const Controls = {
        setPause: (pauseState) => {
            isPaused = pauseState;
            // Resuming needs to manually kick off any paused seeds
            if (!isPaused) {
                for (const seedId in seedStates) {
                    if (seedStates[seedId].status === 'PAUSED') {
                        // A single kick will resume the timeout chain
                        seedStates[seedId].status = 'RUNNING';
                    }
                }
            }
            console.log(isPaused ? 'ALL SEEDS PAUSED' : 'ALL SEEDS RESUMED', 'SYSTEM');
        },
        setSpeed: (delay) => {
            baseDelay = delay;
            console.log(`Speed set to ${delay}ms`, 'SYSTEM');
        },
        reset: () => {
            // Purge state
            globalStats = { total: 0, pass: 0, warn: 0, fail: 0 };
            condensedAuditData.length = 0; // Clear array
            for (const key in seedStates) delete seedStates[key]; // Clear object
            isPaused = false;
            console.log('SYSTEM RESET EXECUTED. STATE PURGED.', 'SYSTEM');
            return true;
        },
        startAudit: () => {
            Controls.reset(); // Always reset before a fresh start
            console.log("AUDIT LAUNCH INITIATED (Pheonix Rising Protocol 2.0)", 'SYSTEM');
            const qaPerSeed = TOTAL_QA / SEEDS;
            for (let i = 0; i < SEEDS; i++) {
                const start = i * qaPerSeed;
                const end = (i + 1) * qaPerSeed;
                const seedQuestions = QA_QUESTIONS.slice(start, end);
                // Stagger the start of each seed slightly
                setTimeout(() => simulateSeed(i, seedQuestions), i * 100);
            }
        },
        // Export logic (Snippet 45)
        exportAudit: () => {
            const data = {
                meta: { project: "Pheonix Rising Protocol 2.0", timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), version: "V2.0_MASTER_CONVERGENCE" },
                global_summary: globalStats,
                seed_states: seedStates,
                v10_roadmap: V10_ROADMAP_IMPLEMENTATION,
                v10_config: V10_CONFIG,
                condensed_audit: condensedAuditData
            };
            console.log("--- V2.0 FINAL EXPORT DATA (Ready for Archival) ---");
            console.log(JSON.stringify(data, null, 2));
            return data;
        }
    };
    // Expose controls globally for external testing/triggering
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        window.PhoenixRisingControls = Controls;
        console.log("--- PHEONIX RISING PROTOCOL 2.0 LOADED ---", 'SYSTEM');
        console.log("System Ready. Auto-starting audit in 100ms for demo consistency.", 'SYSTEM');
    }
    
    // Auto-start a quick audit loop for demo consistency
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
        setTimeout(() => Controls.startAudit(), 100);
    }
})();
